title: Things to Do (for the weekend of October 10th)
description:
Looking for fun things to do around Los Angeles this weekend? From Italian culture and Mexican cuisine to car-free streets and a documentary screening, there’s plenty happening around L.A.!

🇮🇹 Festa Italiana Los Angeles
Celebrate Italian-American heritage in San Pedro with Italian food, live music and performances, vendors, and family-friendly activities.
📅 Saturday, October 10 | 11 AM–10 PM
📍 Downtown San Pedro
🔗 LILAA.org

🌮 Feria de los Moles
Celebrate the flavors and traditions of Mexico with mole, traditional Mexican cuisine, live entertainment, artisans, and cultural activities at Gloria Molina Grand Park.
📅 Sunday, October 11 | 10 AM–6 PM
📍 Gloria Molina Grand Park
🔗 FeriaDeLosMoles.com

🚲 CicLAvia – Heart of LA
Walk, bike, skate, and roll along more than 6.5 miles of car-free streets connecting Echo Park, Downtown, Chinatown, Little Tokyo, the Arts District, and Boyle Heights.
📅 Sunday, October 11 | 9 AM–4 PM
🔗 CicLAvia.org

🎬 Screening of The Librarians
Head to Central Library for a public screening of the award-winning documentary The Librarians, followed by a discussion featuring filmmaker and director Kim A. Snyder and special guests. Seating is first-come, first-served.
📅 Sunday, October 11 | 1:30–4:30 PM
📍 Los Angeles Central Library
🔗 LAPL.org/events
